claims.claim: Gabor Lux argues that how an adventure is told matters as well as what is told.
claims.source: Gabor Lux (Melan), 'OSR Module O1: Against the Ultra-Minimalism', Beyond Fomalhaut, 2017
claims.quote: it also matters how it gets told
claims.page: Against the Ultra-Minimalism, 'The Keep on the Borderlands without...'

claims.claim: Gabor Lux argues that ultra-minimalism strips flavour, depth and inner complexity out of game texts.
claims.source: Gabor Lux (Melan), 'OSR Module O1: Against the Ultra-Minimalism', Beyond Fomalhaut, 2017
claims.quote: Ultra-Minimalism is stripping games of their flavour, depth and inner complexity

claims.claim: Gabor Lux says stylistic elements technically superfluous to an encounter give a game text a voice that sticks in the imagination.
claims.source: Gabor Lux (Melan), 'OSR Module O1: Against the Ultra-Minimalism', Beyond Fomalhaut, 2017
claims.quote: a voice that speaks to us and sticks
claims.page: Against the Ultra-Minimalism, 'The Keep on the Borderlands without...'

claims.claim: Gabor Lux says The Village of Hommlet paints an idyllic rural community by dwelling on random details that do not matter in an adventure.
claims.source: Gabor Lux (Melan), 'OSR Module O1: Against the Ultra-Minimalism', Beyond Fomalhaut, 2017
claims.quote: spending much of its time talking about random details

claims.claim: Gabor Lux says layout and graphic design can improve accessibility but do not replace style.
claims.source: Gabor Lux (Melan), 'OSR Module O1: Against the Ultra-Minimalism', Beyond Fomalhaut, 2017
claims.page: Against the Ultra-Minimalism, 'The Keep on the Borderlands without...'

claims.claim: Gabor Lux says the large Pathfinder and 5e publishers produce encounters that read well and play terribly.
claims.source: Gabor Lux (Melan), 'Aid, Not Replacement', Beyond Fomalhaut, 2018
claims.quote: encounters which read well but play terribly

claims.claim: Gabor Lux revives T. Foster's slogan that a published game text is a creativity aid, not a creativity replacement.
claims.source: Gabor Lux (Melan), 'Aid, Not Replacement', Beyond Fomalhaut, 2018

claims.claim: Tad Davis proposes a middle way between maximalist and minimalist keys resting on a skillful application of economy.
claims.source: Tad Davis, 'On Useful Dungeon Key Entries', ars phantasia, 2013
claims.quote: a skillful application of the principle of economy
claims.page: On Useful Dungeon Key Entries, 'A Via Media'

claims.claim: Tad Davis reports the minimalist camp's argument that read-aloud descriptions take too much time and bore players.
claims.source: Tad Davis, 'On Useful Dungeon Key Entries', ars phantasia, 2013
claims.quote: take up too much time and bore players to tears
claims.page: On Useful Dungeon Key Entries, 'Assessing the Two Approaches'

claims.claim: Tad Davis declines to eliminate boxed text, valuing it as a way of partitioning the information meant for players.
claims.source: Tad Davis, 'On Useful Dungeon Key Entries', ars phantasia, 2013
claims.quote: not convinced that we should completely eliminate the boxed text
claims.page: On Useful Dungeon Key Entries, 'Assessing the Two Approaches'

claims.claim: Tad Davis says that navigating walls of text costs time even when the page is well laid out.
claims.source: Tad Davis, 'On Useful Dungeon Key Entries', ars phantasia, 2013
claims.quote: navigating the walls of text takes time
claims.page: On Useful Dungeon Key Entries, 'Assessing the Two Approaches'

claims.claim: cygnus rewrites each key with a one to two sentence description touching the five senses.
claims.source: cygnus, 'Rewriting Dungeon Keys', The Lady and Tiger, 2023
claims.quote: Short description (one to two sentences), highlighting the 5 senses.

claims.claim: cygnus says focusing on what the characters can immediately perceive is what keeps the description from rambling.
claims.source: cygnus, 'Rewriting Dungeon Keys', The Lady and Tiger, 2023
claims.quote: focusing on what the characters can immediately perceive

claims.claim: cygnus names the Old-School Essentials house style for adventure writing as one of the two models for his rewritten keys.
claims.source: cygnus, 'Rewriting Dungeon Keys', The Lady and Tiger, 2023
claims.quote: the Old-School Essentials house style for adventure writing

claims.claim: Justin Alexander says the one thing he loves about the delve format is putting everything needed to run an area in that area's description.
claims.source: Justin Alexander, 'Are We Really This Stupid?', The Alexandrian, 2011
claims.quote: Putting everything you need to run an encounter area in the description
claims.page: Are We Really This Stupid?, 'Isolated Encounters'
